title: Triangle Families with Large Edge Up-Laplacian Spectral Gap
summary: Let $\mathcal{T}$ be a finite nonempty set of $3$-element subsets of a totally ordered set $V$. We view $\mathcal{T}$ as the set of triangles in the support graph. Let $δ_{1,\mathcal{T}}$ be the signed edge-triangle incidence matrix, and $λ(\mathcal{T})$ the spectral gap of $δ_{1,\mathcal{T}}^Tδ_{1,\mathcal{T}}.$ Our main results show that large $λ(\mathcal{T})$ forces strong overlap and a large minimum degree in the support graph.
